name: Geyser
description:
🌙 MoonVale SMP — Your Forever Home in the Stars

Not just another server. MoonVale is a cozy Vanilla+ sanctuary where real friendships are built alongside real builds — and nothing ever gets wiped.

🏡 Your builds live forever. No resets. No losing your progress. Your creations become part of MoonVale's story permanently.

🎙️ Actually talk to your neighbors. Proximity Voice Chat makes the world feel alive. Pop in a YouTube Music Disc and vibe while you build.

🛡️ Zero tolerance for toxicity. We don't just say it — we enforce it. MoonVale is one of the few servers where the community actually stays friendly.

🌟 Just play. Get rewarded. Unlock ranks, cosmetics, and surprises simply by being online. No paying required — just grind.

⚔️ Something for everyone. Whether you want to farm, duel in the PvP Arena, run a shop, or explore custom Nether biomes — there's always something to do.

📺 Streamers welcome. Consistent creators earn the Streamer Rank with exclusive daily cosmetics.

🎁 Free giveaways, random drops & secret redeemable codes — drop in and claim yours.
